_readme: Homepage hero media slot for the Sigma 1006/1007 cinematic. Nothing here is generated or substituted: until the supplied files are installed the page shows an art-directed placeholder with no furniture. FIDELITY RULES: the footage and stills are shown exactly as supplied. The page never recolors, mirrors, flips, stretches, overlays or re-crops the furniture beyond CSS object-fit:cover; set "focus" (CSS object-position, e.g. "50% 62%") so the Sigma pieces stay inside the crop on both desktop and the 9:16 mobile cut, and supply a separate portrait cut rather than relying on cropping. To install: drop the files in redesign/luxe/media/hero/, fill in poster/video below (see example_when_filled). The poster is rendered server-side (fast LCP, no layout shift); video loads after the page is interactive, and is skipped for reduced-motion and data-saver users, who see the poster only.
label: Sigma I006/I007
